info.title: Concerts Gate Platform API
info.description: Concerts Gate Backend API supporting high-concurrency Flash Sales, Anti-Overselling, Idempotency, and Operations Management. But This is only static swagger.json file, you can use the swagger-ui to test the API endpoints.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of all bookings across the system for monitoring (supports status and concert filters, and search).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by booking status (PendingPayment, Confirmed, Expired, Suspicious, etc.).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by booking code, user email, or customer name.

get.summary: Retrieves full details for any booking order by ID.

patch.summary: Manually updates the status of a booking during incident resolution (e.g. manual confirmation, cancellation, refund).

200.description: Status updated and audit log recorded.

post.summary: Flags a booking as suspicious (fraud / bot detection) or clears a previous flag.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of all concerts (including Draft, Published, Archived) for the operations console.

post.summary: Creates a new concert event and optional initial ticket categories.

put.summary: Updates details of an existing concert.

patch.summary: Changes the publication status of a concert (Draft, Published, Archived, Cancelled).

post.summary: Adds a new ticket category (VIP, Standard, etc.) to an existing concert.

put.summary: Adjusts the total allocated ticket inventory for a category from the operations dashboard.

400.description: New total is lower than sold and reserved quantities combined.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of all vouchers with usage statistics and active status.

post.summary: Creates a new promotional voucher campaign with global and per-account usage limits.

400.description: Voucher code exists or invalid date range.

patch.summary: Toggles the active status of a voucher (pause or reactivate campaign).

post.summary: Registers a new customer account in the Concerts Gate system.

requestBody.description: Registration details (Email, Password, Full Name, Phone Number).

400.description: Invalid payload or email already exists.

post.summary: Authenticates credentials and returns a JWT Bearer token.

get.summary: Retrieves profile details for the currently authenticated user based on JWT claims.

post.summary: Creates a temporary ticket reservation held for 10 minutes (Reserve Tickets).
post.description:
Supports the `X-Idempotency-Key` header to prevent duplicate orders upon network retries.
Employs Optimistic Concurrency Control to eliminate overselling in high-traffic Flash Sales.

parameters.name: X-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Idempotency key from request header (optional but recommended).

requestBody.description: Concert ID, ticket categories, quantities, and optional voucher code.

200.description: Reservation successful, returns booking details and expiration countdown (TTL).

400.description: Invalid payload or event not open for sale.

409.description: Sold out or concurrency conflict during Flash Sale rush.

post.summary: Simulates online payment for a booking order and issues electronic tickets with QR codes.

200.description: Payment completed, status updated to Confirmed and e-tickets returned.

400.description: Invalid booking, expired reservation hold, or already completed.

post.summary: Customer initiates cancellation of an unpaid reservation hold (PendingPayment) to release tickets back to inventory.

400.description: Booking is not in a cancellable status.

get.summary: Retrieves detailed booking information by ID.
Retrieves paginated booking history for the current customer (includes status, amounts, and QR tickets).
Retrieves a paginated list of published concerts available for sale (supports searching, genre filtering, and Flash Sale filter).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search keyword across concert title, artist, or venue.

parameters.name: onlyFlashSale
parameters.description: Filter exclusively for Flash Sale events.

get.summary: Retrieves full details of a concert event including ticket categories (VIP, Standard, etc.) and remaining seat counts.
Retrieves full operational summary metrics: Revenue, Sold tickets, Reserved tickets, Breakdown by status, and Top concerts.

403.description: Forbidden from accessing internal operations dashboard.

get.summary: Checks and audits the inventory consistency (Remaining + Reserved + Sold == Total) for a specific concert event.

post.summary: Validates a promotional voucher code and computes the discount amount before placing a booking order.

requestBody.description: Voucher code and order subtotal amount.

200.description: Voucher is valid, returns calculated discount amount.

422.description: Voucher is invalid, expired, exhausted, or minimum order threshold not met.
